# Klovers (كلوفرز)

> Klovers is an online Korean language academy. It teaches live, interactive Korean classes with a real teacher, in small groups, in English or in Arabic. Klovers serves two equal primary audiences: English speakers, including learners across the United States, and Arabic speakers in Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. Learners anywhere else in the world are welcome too. The academy is registered in Egypt and teaches entirely online.

Key facts:

- Teacher and founder: Reham Elshrkawy. She studied Korean language and literature at the Faculty of Al-Alsun and has taught Korean for 13 years, to more than 200 students.
- Format: live online classes, 60 minutes, once a week. Small groups or private one-to-one lessons.
- Languages of instruction: a learner chooses an English-taught track or an Arabic-taught track. Both are first-class; neither is a translation of the other.
- Path: Hangul Foundation (4 classes, Pre-A1), then Levels 1 to 6 (24 classes over 6 months each). Also: Reading & Speaking practice, and TOPIK exam preparation for students who want it.
- Free first step: a free live trial class and a free online placement test.
- Trial classes run once a month, on the first Friday and Saturday of the month — two in Arabic and two in English. A student booking a trial always has two dates to choose between.
- Prices depend on the learner's country and are shown in local currency on the pricing page. Payment by Vodafone Cash or InstaPay in Egypt (checked by hand after the receipt is uploaded), or by card through Stripe (activated automatically). Every payment is one-time; there are no automatic charges.
- First class guarantee: if a student is not happy after the first class, Klovers refunds or rebooks.
- Contact: WhatsApp +201010003084, email kloversegy@gmail.com.
